user.title: Connect to myEnergy
user.description: Use your myEnergy login. Automatic verification requires a dedicated IMAP mailbox that receives your codes.

mailbox.title: Verification mailbox
mailbox.description: Use a dedicated inbox. For Gmail, enter an app password without spaces. Codes are used only to complete login.

data.subject: Subject template (replace the six digits with {code})

otp.title: Email verification
otp.description: Enter the code just sent by myEnergy. It is used once and is not saved.

progress.login: Signing in and waiting for a fresh verification email. This can take up to two minutes.

error.invalid_auth: Login or verification failed. Check your credentials and start again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Try again later.
error.mailbox_error: Unable to retrieve a fresh verification code. Check the mailbox settings or return to setup and choose manual verification.
error.unexpected_response: myEnergy returned an unexpected response. Check for an integration update.

abort.already_configured: This myEnergy account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Use the same myEnergy account when reauthenticating.

init.title: Energy usage prices
init.description: Enter {currency} per kWh (for AUD, 0.30 means 30 cents). Edit the prices and save; existing hours and block allowances stay the same. New prices start on the chosen date, preserving earlier prices. To change provider, edit these prices and optionally change the plan type or hours. Leave unused export blank; zero is valid. Costs exclude supply fees and demand charges.

data.import_price: Import price (standard / off-peak / first block) per kWh
data.advanced: Change plan type, hours or special settings
data.operation: What would you like to do?
data.import_after_price: Import price per kWh after allowance
data.export_after_price: Export price per kWh after allowance

edit_plan.title: Choose prices to correct
edit_plan.description: You will confirm historical repricing before saving. Existing effective dates stay fixed.

add_plan.title: Choose your energy plan
add_plan.description: Choose a preset and check its hours against your bill. Existing rates and hours are prefilled, so a provider change only needs the values that differ. Prices start on the date chosen on the previous screen.

data.customise_times: Change the preset times or weekdays
data.extras: Add controlled-load or an extra overnight rate

rates.title: Enter your prices
rates.description: Enter {currency} per kWh, including any tax you want tracked (e.g. 0.30 means 30 cents for AUD). Zero is valid. Free midday is priced at zero. Blocks share their allowance across a meter’s channels of the same direction. Monthly/quarterly cycles repeat from the billing-cycle date; month-end dates clamp to the last day.

data.import_price: Standard / off-peak import price per kWh
data.export_price: Export credit per kWh (first block, if stepped)
data.import_after_price: Import price per kWh after allowance
data.import_anchor: Import billing-cycle start date (ignored for daily)
data.export_after_price: Export price per kWh after allowance
data.export_anchor: Export billing-cycle start date (ignored for daily)

times.title: Match the hours on your bill
times.description: Use five-minute boundaries. Ends are exclusive. Overnight windows wrap into the next day. Matching periods use this priority: free midday, peak, shoulder; the standard price covers remaining hours. Peak overrides the broader shoulder window, so weekends can remain shoulder-priced. Only enable periods your plan actually uses.

extras.title: Optional special rates
extras.description: Prices are {currency}/kWh. Leave unused prices blank. The extra overnight period applies every day and overrides other time bands; keep it separate from free midday hours. Controlled load uses only a separately identified channel and never assumes general usage is controlled load. Extra overnight pricing cannot be combined with block import pricing. If pricing controlled load, enter the register confirmed in your NEM12 export or by your distributor; E2 is not assumed to mean controlled load.

confirm.title: Confirm historical correction
confirm.description: Replace the saved prices from {date} until the next saved plan. This intentionally reprices that period when its original readings are imported again. Recent history refreshes automatically; reimport older dates with the import history action.

error.date_order: Choose a date later than the last saved pricing date. Use “Correct a saved pricing period” to fix existing prices.
error.invalid_price: Enter finite, nonnegative prices and a first-block allowance greater than zero.
error.invalid_time: Choose different start and end times, at five-minute boundaries, and at least one day.
error.invalid_extras: Check prices, distinct times at five-minute boundaries, and the confirmed controlled-load register (E2–E9). Block import pricing cannot have an extra overnight rate.
error.cannot_disable: Keep previously configured export and controlled-load prices; use zero for a zero-priced period.

abort.currency_changed: Home Assistant’s currency differs from the saved costs. Restore the original currency before changing prices; existing money statistics cannot be safely relabelled.

options.flat: Flat rate — one price all day
options.two_rate: Peak / off-peak — example 4–9 pm daily peak
options.three_rate: Peak / shoulder / off-peak — Victorian flexible example
options.free_midday: Free midday — example 11 am–2 pm, flat otherwise
options.midday_saver: Midday Power Saver — free, solar soak, peak, off-peak
options.overnight: Cheap overnight / EV — example midnight–6 am
options.block: Two blocks — first Y kWh, then another price

options.quarterly: Every three months from billing-cycle start date

options.new: Set new prices from this date
options.edit: Correct prices in a saved historical period
